selection: First two complete validation video members in the authors' raw archive order, using official validation IDs. All official queries for those videos; no replacement, truncation to gold windows, content inspection or outcome filtering. Access-constrained pilot, not globally random or representative.
predictions: OpenAI/Jev current pipeline returns hit timestamps. Before labels are scored, convert each hit to the contiguous run of adjacent two-second samples with score>=3 containing it, expanded one second at each edge and clamped to video duration. Deduplicate equal windows, preserve hit rank. Gemini returns native MM:SS intervals. No gold-dependent proposal widths.
metrics: R@1 at temporal IoU 0.5 and 0.7, all official queries in the selected videos. Separately report failures and costs. No full-dataset mAP or leaderboard claim.
rankingExperiment: Offline compare current ordering with checked-evidence-first ordering on the SAME saved score traces; no extra model calls or threshold tuning. Evidence means individually refined visual candidate or dominating literal chat match, not guaranteed truth.
budget: Shares remaining $0.42 with Perception Test and all other new inference. No automatic retries.
rights: Official annotations CC BY-NC-SA4.0; local noncommercial evaluation only. Do not redistribute videos or relicense annotations as MIT.
